ns2:course.label: Research Internship
ns2:course.description: Supervised, on-campus, learning experience with faculty engaged in research. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated in the same or subsequent terms to a maximum of 10 hours. Prerequisite: Sophomore standing.
